title: Cabinets and junction boxes: where they are and what they hold
summary: A cabinet or junction box is two objects: its location in Areas and the enclosure in Assets. The enclosure holds rails, terminal strips, I/O cards with their channels, interposing devices, power supplies and earth bars.
roles: A license and a project role that may edit objects

title: Add terminals to a strip
summary: Add numbered terminals to a terminal strip, a channel, an earth bar, a power supply or an instrument in one step, counting on from the last one.
roles: A license and a project role that may edit objects

title: Cables, their cores, and landing a core on a terminal
summary: A cable made from a cable type in the catalog gets its cores at once (pairs with their screens, the overall screen). Each core is landed on a terminal at each end: type part of the terminal and pick it.
roles: A license and a project role that may edit objects

title: Trace a circuit
summary: Follow a circuit from an instrument through its cable, the junction box, the multicore and the marshalling to the I/O channel, with every terminal's reference designation.
roles: Anyone who may view the project

title: Construction status of cores and terminals
summary: Mark cores, cables and terminals as issued for construction, installed, terminated, loop-checked or as-built.
roles: A license and a project role that may edit relationships

title: Cable lengths and the wiring settings
summary: A cable has a length by hand and a length from 3D; E1 uses the one by hand and reports when they differ by more than the project's tolerance. Project settings → Wiring holds the tolerance and which names documents print first.
roles: A project role that may configure the project (settings); a license and a project role that may edit objects (lengths)

title: Import existing or vendor wiring
summary: A termination list of an existing plant or a vendor's panel is imported with a preview: the enclosures, strips, terminals, cables and cores not yet in the project are made, and every core is landed as fixed, with its scope and construction status.
roles: A license and a project role that may edit objects

title: Loop diagrams from the wiring
summary: The loop diagram follows each circuit of a loop through the junction boxes, cables, marshalling and barriers to the I/O channel, with its power feed and its screen, in columns by zone; the loop diagrams of a unit are generated and issued as one set.
roles: A license and a project role that may edit documents

title: Wire list, termination list, cable schedule and I/O list
summary: Lists ▾ on the Wiring page gives the wire list, termination list, cable schedule, junction box schedule and I/O list of what the page shows, made from the model, as Excel or PDF or a first look in the side panel.
roles: Anyone who may view the project; saving for the project needs a role that may edit it

title: Signals and wiring typicals
summary: A wiring typical describes one kind of device: its signals, its field cables and the cores each signal takes, options and variants, and naming patterns. Give it to one device or many: each gets its I/O signals, terminals and cables with their cores landed and numbered.
roles: A license and a project role that may edit objects

title: Make and change a wiring typical by hand
summary: Configuration → Wiring typicals lists the company's and the project's typicals. New typical starts one from a 2-wire transmitter, discrete input, solenoid valve, motor-operated valve or motor starter, and opens it on its sheet: a sample drawn as a loop diagram, where you add signals, cables and places, fill values on its objects and arrange the drawing. Save as typical… makes one from a device that is already wired.
roles: Making a project typical needs a role that may configure the project; a company typical needs Edit library; the sheet needs a role that may edit objects

title: Allocation: propose and accept the wiring
summary: On the Signals tab of the Wiring page, Propose wiring fills each signal's empty places, junction box, multicore pair, marshalling and I/O channel, keeping the segregation rules, redundancy groups and spares, and says why for each choice; choose another junction box for one device or many, and accept a cell, a row, a column or everything.
roles: A license and a project role that may edit relationships

title: Changes after issue: the wire move list
summary: Once wiring is issued for construction, a change is a list for the field on the Changes tab of the Wiring page: what to lift and what to land, terminal by terminal, ticked off when done and exported for the crew.
roles: A license and a project role that may edit relationships

title: Entity check and voltage budget
summary: For an intrinsically safe loop E1 checks the barrier against the device and the cable for its length (the entity check), and for every loop with a supply the voltage left at the device at 20 mA. A value it needs and does not have is reported as missing.
roles: Anyone who may view the project

title: Cabinet fill and heat balance
summary: On a cabinet's or junction box's page: each strip and card as a bar of what is used, spare and free, and the cabinet's heat balance from physics: its inside and top temperature, the margin to its limit, the cooling missing, and which devices give the most heat.
roles: Anyone who may view the project

title: Exchange the I/O list with the control-system vendor
summary: Export the I/O list of a unit or a cabinet for the control-system vendor, and import their list back: a channel they kept comes back fixed, a channel they changed is a finding, and is moved to when you apply it.
roles: Exporting: anyone who may view the project. Importing: a license and a project role that may edit relationships

title: Markers and the block diagram
summary: Export the wire, terminal and cable markers of a cabinet for the printer's software, and make the cable block diagram: every cable of a unit or cabinet with where it comes from and goes to, as a document.
roles: Anyone who may view the project

title: Fieldbus segments
summary: Make a fieldbus segment from a segment typical, place Foundation Fieldbus H1 and Profibus PA devices on its coupler ports within its limits, and see the segment against its limits on its page.
roles: A license and a project role that may create objects; anyone who may view the project sees the segment view

title: The Wiring page and its Signals tab
summary: The Wiring page of a unit, loop, enclosure, cable or device shows every signal in one row with its whole path, from the field cable through the junction box, multicore and marshalling to its I/O channel, with the status and origin of each place.
roles: Viewing: anyone who may view the project. Setting typicals, status and Fix: a license and a project role that may edit relationships

title: The path of one signal
summary: Press T on a row of the Wiring page: the path panel shows the signal from its device to its I/O channel as a line of places, each link with its cable and construction status.
roles: Anyone who may view the project

title: The cable schedule
summary: The Cables tab of the Wiring page: every cable with its type, its two ends, the cores used and spare, its length and its status; set the status of many cables or fix them in one step.
roles: Viewing: anyone who may view the project. Status and Fix: a license and a project role that may edit relationships

title: The cable editor
summary: A cable as left end, core, right end: pick a terminal for a core, land several cores in order, swap two, mark spare, disconnect, and see the free cores against the spare target.
roles: A license and a project role that may edit relationships

title: The strip designer
summary: A terminal strip as a table of its terminals and accessories in order, with what lands on the field side and the system side: move terminals, number them, add terminals, end stops, partitions and jumpers.
roles: A license and a project role that may edit objects

title: Terminal strip and cable block diagrams
summary: Make the terminal strip diagram of a strip or a cabinet, and the cable block diagram of a unit or cabinet, as documents generated from the model: export PDF or Excel, revise and issue them.
roles: A license and a project role that may make documents

title: Potentials and the net view
summary: The Potentials tab lists every potential, such as +24V, with its terminals, enclosures, supply load, fuses and parts; the net view shows its terminals, jumpers and fuses per enclosure, and assigns terminals to it.
roles: Viewing: anyone who may view the project. Changing: a license and a project role that may edit objects and relationships

title: Checks: the wiring findings
summary: The Checks tab lists every wiring finding of the page's scope, grouped by rule, with Go to; accept a finding with a reason, or reopen it.
roles: Viewing: anyone who may view the project. Accepting: a license and a project role that may edit relationships

title: The segregation matrix and wiring settings
summary: Set which segregation classes may share a junction box, strip, cable, route or enclosure, the spare percentage and the wire number pattern, on the Checks tab of the Wiring page.
roles: A project role that may configure the project

title: Number wires
summary: Give the cores and wires of a unit, an enclosure or a cable their wire numbers from the project's pattern, with a preview of every change; a locked number never changes.
roles: A license and a project role that may edit objects

title: Cable routes: trays, conduits and fill
summary: Add tray, ladder, conduit, duct and trench segments with their capacity and fill limit, route cables through them in order, and see each segment's fill and each cable's routed length.
roles: A license and a project role that may edit objects

title: The field view of the wire moves
summary: The wire moves in big rows under their enclosure and strip, for a tablet in the field: one tap per move done, and a comment back to design.
roles: A license and a project role that may edit relationships

title: Compare wiring with a revision
summary: Compare the wiring of a unit, an enclosure, a cable or a device with an issued revision or version of its loop diagrams, or with a date: what was added, removed and changed, connection by connection.
roles: Anyone who may view the project

title: Draw the cable network on a single line diagram
summary: Field devices, junction boxes and cabinets drawn on a single line diagram, joined by cables: each line is a real cable with its tag, the default type for its two ends and its cores. Draw a unit's whole network from the model, and drag a cable's end to move it to another junction box.
roles: A license and a project role that may edit drawings and objects; the default cable types need a role that may configure the project

training.topic: The cable network on a single line diagram
